featured.source: 中文文章/2024-09-14-工资就是吃饭钱.md

note.zh-CN: 从劳动力也是商品讲起：为什么不管在哪、做什么工作，工资总是刚好够生活。
note.en: Labour is a commodity too, so wherever you work and whatever you do, wages just about cover the cost of living.

featured.source: 中文文章/2024-09-16-永远不要指望自己明天会读书——关于读书的一些经验和感想.md

note.zh-CN: 三条读书经验：别指望明天，别硬读不喜欢的书，要主动去读。
note.en: Three lessons on reading: don't count on tomorrow, don't force books you dislike, and read actively.

featured.source: 中文文章/2024-12-20-苏轼学佛又吃肉，他是如何做到不内耗的？.md

note.zh-CN: 学佛的苏轼怎么给吃肉找理由：专吃死物、自我安慰，还有漱口。
note.en: How Su Shi, a Buddhist, justified eating meat: from “the chicken was going to die anyway” to rinsing his mouth.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-09-16-永远不要指望自己明天会读书——关于读书的一些经验和感想.md
quotes.text: 你现在没时间读书，以后也不会有时间读书的。
quotes.en: If you have no time to read now, you won't have time later either.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2025-05-04-外卖，是穷人吃得多还是富人吃得多？.md
quotes.text: 穷人靠外卖维持生存；中产靠外卖节约时间；富人靠外卖享受生活。
quotes.en: The poor order takeaway to get by, the middle class to save time, and the rich to enjoy life.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2026-10-05-吉隆坡的天气分析.md
quotes.text: 凌晨和下午雨后会凉快很多，这个点出门一般也比较舒适。
quotes.en: It cools down a lot before dawn and after the afternoon rain; those are usually the most comfortable times to go out.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-09-24-完成和完美，哪个更重要？.md
quotes.text: 完成是最重要的，先求完成，再求完美。
quotes.en: Finishing matters most: finish first, perfect later.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2026-10-11-论大走理论（The Great Walk Theory）.md
quotes.text: 一分钱都不花，唯一必要的装备就是遮体的衣裤。
quotes.en: It costs nothing. The only equipment you need is something to wear.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-10-14-如何理解第二种价值形式：B总和的或扩大的价值形式？.md
quotes.text: 塞北的牛羊和南海的珊瑚，可能从来没有交换过，但我们仍然可以确定它们交换时应该遵循什么样的交换比例。
quotes.en: Cattle from beyond the northern frontier and coral from the South China Sea may never have been traded, yet we can still say at what ratio they should be exchanged.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2025-01-02-有钱人的烦恼：读《煤老板自述三十年》.md
quotes.text: 而我年纪轻轻就看到了这本书，从这个方面讲，我觉得自己实在比大多数煤老板都更有智慧。
quotes.en: I read this book while still young, so in that respect I really do feel wiser than most coal bosses.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-09-19-有些执念和担忧，你把它当成屁，它就真的变成屁了.md
quotes.text: 当然，我这些话也都是屁话。道理谁都懂，但是你在那个情境之下，总是控制不住自己的感情。
quotes.en: Of course, all this is just hot air. Everyone knows the theory; in the moment, you still can't control your feelings.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2025-05-27-AI拒绝关机，背后真相远比你想的无聊.md
quotes.text: AI只是一种工具，和历史上任何其他工具一样，重点不是工具本身，重点是被谁使用、如何使用。
quotes.en: AI is just a tool. As with every other tool in history, what matters is not the tool but who uses it and how.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-09-14-工资就是吃饭钱.md
quotes.text: 这辈子不行，我们还有下辈子嘛！
quotes.en: If it doesn't work out in this life, there's always the next one!

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-11-06-司马迁为什么能够写出《史记》？.md
quotes.text: 每个人都有权利选择自己的一生，极致的屈辱面对崇高的理想，将变成最强劲的动力。
quotes.en: Everyone has the right to choose their own life. Extreme humiliation, set against a lofty ideal, becomes the strongest drive of all.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2025-01-28-酒精的作用：抑制人的抑制功能.md
quotes.text: 所以我现在是非必要不喝酒，毕竟喝酒伤身，还是少喝为妙啊。
quotes.en: So these days I don't drink unless I have to. Alcohol harms the body; the less, the better.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-09-13-范仲淹没见过岳阳楼，李白也没去过天姥山.md
quotes.text: 我们的目标是感动读者、说服读者、让读者能够接受我们传达的信息，任何条条框框如果阻碍了我们的这个目标，都应该打破。
quotes.en: Our goal is to move readers, persuade them and help them accept what we have to say. Any rule that gets in the way of that should be broken.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-09-21-人行通州，月明中秋.md
quotes.text: 秋天的时候一定要考虑来北京通州，感受一下这“人行通州，月明中秋”的生活。
quotes.en: In autumn, think about coming to Tongzhou in Beijing for a life of walking its streets under the Mid-Autumn moon.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-09-20-读书报告：《边水往事》.md
quotes.text: 只有面对真实，我们才能找到建设美好世界的方法。
quotes.en: Only by facing reality can we find ways to build a better world.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2026-07-27-气候对一个人的身体影响能有多大？.md
quotes.text: 适宜的气候可以改善人的身心状态，大家平时出差、旅游可以留意一下这个因素。
quotes.en: A suitable climate can improve how you feel in body and mind. It's worth keeping in mind when you travel.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2026-09-19-用微信读书看英文原著.md
quotes.text: 其实直接用微信读书，就完全能满足看英文原著的所有需求。
quotes.en: WeChat Read on its own covers everything you need for reading English books in the original.

quotes.source: 中文文章/2024-09-16-永远不要指望自己明天会读书——关于读书的一些经验和感想.md
quotes.text: 我认为自己随时读书的习惯根本上改变了我的人生。
quotes.en: My habit of reading whenever I can has fundamentally changed my life.
